name: Interest on delayed payment of tax
description: Interest payable on net cash liability for tax paid after due date at 18% p.a., or 24% p.a. for undue/excess claim of ITC or reduction in output tax liability.

parameters.sourceNote: Proviso to Section 50(1) inserted by Finance (No. 2) Act 2019 w.r.e.f. 01-07-2017 provides for interest only on net tax liability paid through electronic cash ledger.
